text:
leah.carter: FYI team — deploy-bot plans to unpin runtime 2.16 -> 2.17-canary for canary-eu tonight at 21:30 UTC. Observability picked up an increase in memory footprint for long-seq workloads on quant-llama3. I want a short 'pinback' + rollback playbook before we start.

max.gonzalez: Wasn't there a prior longseq regression? We should default to pin+drain if anything looks off.

leah.carter: Agreed. Proposed strategy: scoped canary only, apply conservative KV cache cap + lowered batching, run short synthetic probes, and have pinback command ready. If probes show >=10% p95 mem regression or error rate >4% for 5m, pin immediately. If pin fails to stabilize, full rollback.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: upgrade runtime 2.16 -> 2.17-canary @ 2026-04-05T21:30Z for group: canary-eu. Cancel: `deploy-bot cancel 3312345670`. Pinback: `deployctl pin runtime 2.16 --scope=canary-eu`. Full rollback: `deploy-bot rollback --to=2.16 --scope=canary-eu`.

adeep.singh: SDK compatibility note: the canary changes the function-calling header encoding. Client shim included in SDK v1.10.0. Recommend pinning customers to >=1.10.0 in the notes. I'll push a quick compatibility matrix update.

taylor_sre: Oncall will monitor. Please spell out exact thresholds and commands so I can add to the runbook and alert config.

max.gonzalez: Quick rollback/playback steps (copyable):
1) `deployctl pin runtime 2.16 --scope=canary-eu`
2) `deploybot notify --role=edge --scope=canary-eu`  # start drain wave
3) If pods don't replace cleanly: `kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deployment/runtime-canary` and `kubectl delete pod -l app=runtime-canary --now`
4) Verify with: `metrics-diff --metric=runtime.mem.p95 --baseline=pre-unpin --window=15m`

leah.carter: Add thresholds to the release note: warning at p95 mem +7% or error rate >2% for 5m; critical at p95 mem +10% or error rate >4% for 5m. We'll treat pin+drain as the first action on critical breach.

qa_bot: QA plan: run two synthetic suites — shortseq (normal) and longseq (stress). Schedule: probes at T+4m and T+20m. Report back with p50/p75/p95 and request ids.

adeep.singh: I'll update the SDK repo and include a backwards-compatible shim for 1.9.x, but call out that 1.9 may need the shim to avoid 400s on function payloads. Recommendation: customers upgrade to 1.10+.

max.gonzalez: Config snippet for canary configmap override: 
``n
runtime.kv.cache_limit=9GB
runtime.batch.max_tokens=480
service.circuit_breaker.error_rate=0.05
```
(I'll apply via kustomize overlay)

leah.carter: Can someone draft a short external-facing changelog blurb? Keep it non-alarming and note regional canary only.

adeep.singh: Draft: "Performance and kernel improvements rolling out to a regional canary with temporary memory safeguards. No action needed; contact support for regressions."

taylor_sre: Alerts I'll add: warn if mem.p95 delta >7% (email), critical if >10% (pager). Error-rate warn >2% (email), critical >4% (pager). Link runbook: https://internal/runbooks/pinback-runtime-canary

deploy-bot: Update: unpin executed at 2026-04-05T21:30Z 1:32Z monitors active. Use `/status 3312345670` for live checks.

max.gonzalez: First 8 minutes: longseq p95 +4%, p75 +6%, errors stable. Looks safe so far.

qa_bot: T+4m results: longseq p50 +2%, p75 +7%, p95 +9% (below critical). No spike in 4xx/5xx.

leah.carter: Holding. If p95 crosses +10% or sustained error rate >4% for 5m, execute pin. Taylor, stand by to run pin play.

taylor_sre: Standing by. 

qa_bot: T+20m results: p95 +11% and increasing slowly; error rate 0.9% -> 1.2%. Trend looks concerning.

max.gonzalez: p95 just crossed our critical threshold (+11% > +10%). Recommend immediate pin+drain.

leah.carter: Approving pinback. Execute: `deployctl pin runtime 2.16 --scope=canary-eu` and `deploybot notify --role=edge --scope=canary-eu`.

deploy-bot: Pin command acknowledged. Pinning in progress...

taylor_sre: Pin applied. Draining started. Validating rollback metrics.

max.gonzalez: After pin: metrics T+5m post-pin: p95 back to +3% vs baseline, error rate stable. Looks like pin restored baseline.

leah.carter: Good. We will not do a full rollback. Action items: adeep to finalize SDK compatibility note and link to SDK patch; max to file a telemetry ticket to track longseq memory over next 48h; me to open release-note PR with canary caveat and pinback summary.

adeep.singh: Filed SDK PR and compatibility matrix: https://git.internal/sdk/PR-4321 (includes shim + upgrade recommendation).

leah.carter: I'll post an internal summary in #release-notes in 1h if canary is stable. Reopen thread if anything regresses. Thanks. :thumbsup:

(reacts: :rotating_light: from taylor_sre, :white_check_mark: from max.gonzalez)
